concerns.text: Plan defines the FDR family as '3 metrics x 5 stages x 2 bands = 30 tests' (including Wake), but T006 fits only '3 × 4 × 2 = 24 models' (N1/N2/N3/REM). No task covers the plan's 5-stage/30-test family definition; the discrepancy changes the correction family itself. Either add Wake-stage models or reconcile the plan's family size.

FR-012 requires Shapiro-Wilk to SELECT the correlation method (Pearson vs Spearman). T006's shapiro_diagnostics only records diagnostics to method_selection.csv; no task implements any method-selection behavior. If the LME deviation supersedes FR-012, the spec must be amended first — as written, the FR's selection requirement has no implementing task.
